thread:
Asha Patel: Kicking off Coriolis onboarding here — want to align on stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and any potential renewal risk flags. Can folks confirm availability for a short sync next Tues (3/31)?
Jordan Kim: I can do 3/31 10am PT. I'll own SSO + auth integration.
Marcus Lee: I'm the AE on this account — flagged one renewal risk: customer needs full GA in 8 weeks or they escalate procurement. We should surface that in timeline.
Leo Martinez: I'll take model throughput & prod runbook items. Goal they hit 300 req/s p95 latency <150ms on our dedicated footprint; need perf testing window.
Samira Khan: I'll schedule enablement sessions and own training materials + feedback capture. Week of Apr 7 works for me.
Asha Patel: Thanks. Quick proposed owner map and milestones (draft):
```
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, stakeholder roster (Asha)
- Week 1: SSO + infra handoff (Jordan)
- Week 2: Integration & perf testing (Leo)
- Week 3: Enablement + runbook review (Samira)
- Week 4: Pilot validation + quality signoff (Asha)
- Week 6: GA readiness review (Marcus)
```
Asha Patel: Add any missing owners. Also need acceptance criteria. My suggested success criteria: 1) demo flow completes end-to-end from their UI, 2) two-week stability with <1% error rate, 3) throughput & latency targets met, 4) knowledge transfer completed.
Jordan Kim: Add SSO test matrix and rollback plan to acceptance criteria. I'll attach a short checklist.
Jordan Kim: ```
SSO checklist:
- IdP metadata exchanged
- Test user login + role mapping
- Token lifetime & rotation validated
- Fallback login flow verified
```
Marcus Lee: Procurement timeline note — customer needs PO in by May 15 to keep current pricing. If integration slips beyond May 1, ping me and we escalate to customer execs.
Samira Khan: For enablement, I'll run three 45m sessions: Admin, Developer, Ops. Capturing feedback via a 5-question pulse form after each. I'll post the form link after the first session.
Asha Patel: Can we get a perf window — Leo, suggest we run load test Wed Apr 8 9am PT for 2 hours?
Leo Martinez: Works for me. I'll reserve two GPUs on dedicated pool and share a small load script.
Asha Patel: Onboarding doc owners: please update the shared doc with owners and dates by EOD Friday. I'll circulate meeting invite for 3/31 10am PT now.
OnboardBot: Meeting scheduled: Coriolis Onboarding Kickoff — Tue Mar 31 10:00 AM PT. Invite sent to participants. Calendar: https://calendar.service/meet/abc123
Samira Khan: One more ask — can we capture their primary success metric? Marcus, can you confirm whether retention or time-to-value is the main renewal driver?
Marcus Lee: Primary is time-to-value. They measure TTV by time-to-first-inference for key workflows and percent of daily active users using the feature. I'll share their measurement doc.
Asha Patel: Great. I'll add TTV target to acceptance criteria. If anyone sees blockers (legal, infra, data sharing), call them out here early.
Jordan Kim: FYI legal asked for DPA appendix; I've looped Legal (cc'd).
Leo Martinez: Small note on perf: their input length distribution is wide; can we ask product to freeze a canonical prompt set for tests?
Samira Khan: I'll include a short prompt-set capture in the prework for the devs.
Asha Patel: Cool. Action items summary (quick):
- Marcus: procurement dates + customer measurement doc (by Thu)
- Jordan: SSO matrix + DPA follow-up (by Fri)
- Leo: perf script + reserved GPUs (by Apr 6)
- Samira: enablement schedule + pulse form (by Apr 3)
- Asha: circulate final kickoff agenda + send calendar invite (today)
Asha Patel: Thanks all — :thumbsup: we'll use this thread for quick async updates and move decisions to follow-up notes in the shared doc.
Samira Khan: Added checklist to doc and flagged two sections for feedback capture.
Jordan Kim: DPA thread started with Legal, updates incoming.
Leo Martinez: Perf script posted to the runbook repo: https://git.internal/runbooks/coriolis-load-test
Marcus Lee: Shared measurement doc in drive. Also re-iterating: if integration slips, we should schedule an exec readout to avoid renewal risk.
Asha Patel: Closing the loop — last callouts? If none, we'll lock the agenda in the invite.
Marcus Lee: Nothing else from AE side. Looks good.
Samira Khan: All good.
OnboardBot: Thread archived by OnboardBot for inactivity after 6 hours.
